messages.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

A Vector Network Analyzer fits in the AI data-center test workflow at the high-speed connectivity / signal-integrity layer: server PCBA high-speed trace testing, PCB insertion-loss and TDR testing, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, network-switch VNA testing, and silicon-photonics optical VNA testing are all listed as R&S solution mappings for the AI server / data-center ecosystem [18]. The instrument role is a VNA-based electrical/optical interconnect validation tool; raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a “VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER” [38], and raw evidence also states that the R&S ZNA67EXT vector network analyzer system consists of one R&S ZNA67 vector network analyzer plus up to four external test sets [37].

answer.text: A Vector Network Analyzer fits in the AI data-center test workflow at the high-speed connectivity / signal-integrity layer: server PCBA high-speed trace testing, PCB insertion-loss and TDR testing, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, network-switch VNA testing, and silicon-photonics optical VNA testing are all listed as R&S solution mappings for the AI server / data-center ecosystem [18]. The instrument role is a VNA-based electrical/optical interconnect validation tool; raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a “VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER” [38], and raw evidence also states that the R&S ZNA67EXT vector network analyzer system consists of one R&S ZNA67 vector network analyzer plus up to four external test sets [37].
